# The Independent

> Breaking news, comment, features, and analysis from the UK, US, and around the world.

The Independent is a digital news publisher covering UK and world news, politics, business, climate, culture, lifestyle, travel, and sport, with dedicated regional editions and specialist verticals including Indy100 and Voices.

## Home & Editions
- [The Independent Home](https://www.independent.co.uk/): Main homepage with top stories, breaking news, comment, and features.
- [US Edition](https://www.independent.co.uk/us): US-focused homepage with American politics, culture, and breaking news.
- [Asia Edition](https://www.independent.co.uk/asia): Asia-focused homepage highlighting regional and global developments.
- [News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news): Central news landing page for UK, world, and live coverage.
- [Voices](https://www.independent.co.uk/voices): Opinion, columns, editorials, and personal essays from contributors.
- [Climate](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change): Climate and environment reporting, analysis, and explainers.

## UK News
- [UK News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk): UK-wide reporting on politics, crime, health, education, and public affairs.
- [UK Politics](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics): Westminster, elections, policy, parties, and government coverage.
- [Home News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news): Domestic breaking news, public services, transport, and local developments.
- [Crime](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime): Crime reporting, court cases, policing, and criminal justice updates.
- [Health News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health): UK and global health reporting, NHS news, and medical developments.
- [Education News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/education): Schools, universities, policy changes, and student issues.

## World News
- [World News](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world): International news, conflicts, diplomacy, and global affairs.
- [Europe](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe): European politics, security, elections, and regional developments.
- [Americas](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas): News from North and South America, including US developments.
- [US Politics](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics): White House, Congress, elections, and policy reporting.
- [US Crime](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime): US criminal cases, policing, courts, and investigations.
- [Middle East](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east): Regional conflict, diplomacy, and political developments.
- [Asia](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia): News from South, East, and Southeast Asia.
- [Africa](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa): Reporting on politics, conflict, development, and society across Africa.

## Business & Money
- [Business](https://www.independent.co.uk/business): Business news, markets, companies, economics, and consumer developments.
- [Voices on Business](https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/business): Opinion and analysis on economics, work, and corporate issues.
- [IndyBest](https://www.independent.co.uk/extras/indybest): Product reviews, buying guides, and consumer recommendations.
- [Money](https://www.independent.co.uk/money): Personal finance, savings, mortgages, pensions, and household budgeting.
- [Tech](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech): Technology news, digital products, platforms, and industry developments.

## Climate, Science & Health
- [Climate](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change): Climate crisis reporting, policy coverage, and environmental analysis.
- [Science](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science): Scientific discoveries, research, space, and innovation news.
- [Space](https://www.independent.co.uk/space): Space exploration, astronomy, launches, and agency updates.
- [Environment](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/environment): Environment news on wildlife, pollution, and conservation.
- [Health](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health): Public health, medicine, NHS reporting, and wellness developments.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport): Sports homepage with live coverage, results, analysis, and features.
- [Football](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football): Football news, transfers, match reports, and major competitions.
- [Rugby](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/rugby): Rugby union and league coverage, fixtures, and analysis.
- [Cricket](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/cricket): Cricket news, series coverage, and match reporting.
- [Tennis](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/tennis): Grand Slams, tours, rankings, and player news.
- [Golf](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/golf): Tournament coverage, rankings, and player updates.
- [Formula 1](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/motor-racing/formula1): Formula 1 races, teams, drivers, and championship news.
- [US Sport](https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/us-sport): American sports coverage including major leagues and events.

## Arts, Entertainment & Lifestyle
- [Arts & Entertainment](https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment): Film, TV, music, books, and celebrity coverage.
- [Films](https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/films): Film reviews, release news, interviews, and features.
- [TV & Radio](https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/tv): Television and radio reviews, news, and commentary.
- [Music](https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/music): Music news, album reviews, interviews, and live coverage.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style): Lifestyle features on relationships, wellbeing, and everyday living.
- [Fashion](https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/fashion): Fashion news, trends, runway coverage, and style features.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/food-and-drink): Recipes, restaurant news, drinks coverage, and food features.
- [Love & Sex](https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/love-sex): Relationships, dating, sex, and personal advice features.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel): Travel news, destination guides, advice, and transport updates.
- [Travel News & Advice](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice): Airline, rail, border, and practical travel updates.
- [Europe Travel](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/europe): Destination features and travel advice across Europe.
- [UK Travel](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/uk): UK destination guides, breaks, and domestic travel ideas.
- [Long Haul Travel](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/long-haul): Long-distance destination coverage and trip inspiration.
- [Hotels](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/hotels): Hotel reviews, openings, and accommodation recommendations.

## Opinion & Features
- [Voices](https://www.independent.co.uk/voices): Comment, analysis, and first-person perspectives on current issues.
- [Editorials](https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/editorials): The Independent's editorial positions on major topics.
- [Letters](https://www.independent.co.uk/voices/letters): Reader responses and published letters to the editor.
- [Long Reads](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/long_reads): In-depth features, investigations, and narrative reporting.
- [Features](https://www.independent.co.uk/topic/features): Feature articles spanning news, culture, and lifestyle.

## Special Projects & Brands
- [Indy100](https://www.indy100.com/): Independent-owned site covering internet culture, trends, and social media news.
- [Bulletin](https://www.independent.co.uk/bulletin): Newsletters and curated updates from The Independent.
- [Premium](https://www.independent.co.uk/premium): Subscriber offering for exclusive journalism and premium features.
- [Podcasts](https://www.independent.co.uk/topic/podcasts): Podcast coverage, audio journalism, and related features.
- [Video](https://www.independent.co.uk/tv): Video hub with news clips, interviews, and visual reporting.

## Puzzles, Newsletters & Account
- [Newsletters](https://www.independent.co.uk/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major topics and curated briefings.
- [Puzzles](https://www.independent.co.uk/games): Games and puzzles including crosswords and brain teasers.
- [Crosswords](https://www.independent.co.uk/games/crossword): Crossword puzzles and archive access.
- [My Account](https://www.independent.co.uk/my-account): Account management for subscriptions, preferences, and saved content.
- [Notifications](https://www.independent.co.uk/my-account/notifications): Manage breaking news and topic alert preferences.
